_comment: Workforce oversight mapping (P9b). HR data already lives in operator-owned Google Sheets, so no new adapter is needed: this file only names which sheet and which column means what. Copy the 'workforce' block below into config/integrations.json, merged under the tenant key next to 'sheets_registers', and replace SET_... values. IMPORTANT: 'register' and 'range' must already exist in that tenant's sheets_registers block. Column names are the literal header text of the spreadsheet, so they are usually Uzbek Latin or Cyrillic (Ism, Holat, Sana). Status words are matched case-insensitively and are casefolded on load. No key other than the ones shown below is accepted inside a register: an unknown key is refused rather than ignored, because a typo in a column name would otherwise look exactly like an empty roster.
_note_attendance: absent_statuses must be declared explicitly. An empty list means the status column is unreadable, and workforce.attendance refuses rather than reporting that nobody is absent.
_note_shifts: hours_column is optional. A blank or unreadable cell reports hours as null, never as zero, and is counted in unreadable_hours.
_note_workload: open_statuses and done_statuses together decide what counts as outstanding. Strictly ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) are compared against the platform clock; an ambiguous cell such as 10.01.2026 is counted in unparsable_due rather than guessed.
